name: Environmental protection is not only the government’s responsibility but also ours.
trans: 环境保护不仅是政府的责任，也是我们的责任。

name: We should raise environmental awareness and learn environmental protection knowledge from an early age.
trans: 我们应该提高环保意识，从小学习环保知识。

name: Environmental education plays an important role in helping students develop eco-friendly habits.
trans: 环保教育在帮助学生养成环保习惯方面起着重要作用。

name: As college students, we can build a green campus by sorting garbage properly and saving energy.
trans: 作为大学生，我们可以通过正确垃圾分类和节约能源来建设绿色校园。

name: Living a low-carbon life means taking public transport and reducing the use of plastic bags.
trans: 过低碳生活意味着乘坐公共交通、减少使用塑料袋。

name: We should put environmental awareness into practice instead of just talking about it.
trans: 我们应把环保意识付诸实践，而不是只停留在口头上。

name: Recycling waste paper and bottles can help reduce waste and protect natural resources.
trans: 回收废纸和瓶子有助于减少浪费、保护自然资源。

name: Taking part in environmental activities enables us to spread environmental knowledge to more people.
trans: 参加环保活动使我们能够向更多人传播环保知识。

name: It is important to strike a balance between economic development and environmental protection.
trans: 平衡经济发展与环境保护很重要。

name: Everyone should start from small things, such as saving water and electricity in daily life.
trans: 每个人都应从小事做起，比如在日常生活中节约水电。

name: Protecting the environment is protecting our own future.
trans: 保护环境就是保护我们自己的未来。

name: Only by working together can we create a greener and more sustainable world.
trans: 只有共同努力，我们才能创造一个更绿色、更可持续的世界。

name: It is widely acknowledged that environmental protection is of great importance to human survival.
trans: 众所周知，环境保护对人类生存至关重要。

name: There is no denying that environmental education helps students develop green habits.
trans: 不可否认，环保教育有助于学生养成绿色习惯。

name: As college students, we should start from small things and put environmental awareness into practice.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该从小事做起，把环保意识付诸实践。

name: Only by protecting the environment can we achieve sustainable development.
trans: 只有保护环境，我们才能实现可持续发展。

name: Taking part in environmental activities enables us to learn more environmental knowledge and spread it to others.
trans: 参加环保活动使我们能够学习更多环保知识并传播给他人。

name: While economic development is important, we should also pay attention to environmental protection.
trans: 虽然经济发展很重要，但我们也应关注环境保护。
